chapter.heading: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm, a Song.
chapter.v:
God be
merciful unto us, and bless us,And cause his face to shine upon us; [Selah

That thy
way may be known upon earth,Thy salvation among all nations.

Let the
peoples praise thee, O God;Let all the peoples praise thee.

Oh let
the nations be glad and sing for joy;For thou wilt judge the peoples with equity,And govern the nations upon earth. [Selah

Let the
peoples praise thee, O God;Let all the peoples praise thee.

The earth
hath yielded its increase:God, even our own God, will bless us.

God will
bless us;And all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
